step.cmd: In FTS, determine if a registration number is on file for the change of address issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 11.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision Type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .
Go to step 11.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the revised registration corresponding to the change of address issue.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 3 - An overpayment resulted due to a definite disentitlement .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim that is converted to MPS.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 53 - Claim transfer .
Remarks line 1: Type “Change of address in a new region and CS 8.”
Remarks line 2: Type “The new SCC is [SCC number].”
Remarks line 3: Enter any other relevant information for processing the claim.
Remarks line 4: Enter your first name and last name.
Complete: Select C - Yes to clear the registration number.
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the AI WI.
